name: Balurghat Technologies Limited
about: Balurghat Technologies Limited provides transport services in India. It offers logistics solutions and supply chain services. The company is also involved in travel and tourism business; and sale of fuel through petrol pumps. It serves pharmaceuticals, FMGC, and retail and fashion industries. The company was formerly known as Balurghat Transport Co. Ltd. and changed its name to Balurghat Technologies Limited in July 2000. Balurghat Technologies Limited was founded in 1952 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
